requirements.statement: New required reviews must not pass solely through artifact presence, and unresolved blocking findings from either actor must block release without breaking historical review manifests.

claims.statement: Readiness rejects invalid, stale, foreign-run or blocked structured reviews, preserves legacy review behavior, and does not allow a valid review to replace decisive evidence.

evidence_requirements.description: Focused readiness and review-record regression tests
Evidence-grounded review of expectations and counterexamples

claims.residual_uncertainty: Record checks do not prove reviewer identity, independence, oracle correctness, human understanding or complete defect detection. CI transport of ignored review artifacts and automatic manifest selection remain unimplemented.
